scope: November 24 user revision for independent frozen W57 evaluations after both learning heads and both natural collector tails finished
predecessor: Original W57 two leases govern all training and its natural tails. Original stage and long qualification dispatcher remains authoritative.
frozen: same exact B/P/R/PR/blind snapshots, build, speed initialization, normalization, frozen timing checkpoint and physical constraints
one official attempt per manifest cell, no additional seed or training
case-wise E30 before E60, E300/E600 in original PR dispatcher only
raw_slots: Legacy 0/1 plus optional 2..5 in the same physical lease directory, under the original flock admission mutex. Both old P processes continue on their original CPUs.
index_adoption: Two earlier protocol tasks must still require a fresh admission. Hold the shared mutex until the frozen launcher writes its real canonical receipt and runner PID. The original two queue workers later join that very receipt.
cross_case_order: Once an identity has completed both mechanism modes and its own E30, its own E60 can overlap the remaining independent cases.

accounting.evaluation_ceiling_selection: Select only additional work that fits sampled CPU/RAM/GPU/disk/I/O headroom after other projects and auxiliary jobs.

evidence.four_to_six_trial: Observe four real physical streams for at least 115 wall seconds. Require at least 15% more total physical progress than the initial pair and at least 85% retention of the original P pair rate.
evidence.six_readmission: Compare two disjoint windows of at least 115 seconds against the actual four-slot window. Sum historical single-stream work at matched route, case and simulated time. Both totals must increase, common streams together must retain 85% in both, and a common stream must not fall below 75% in both. Record the raw rates, each individual ratio, reference attempts and resource headroom.
evidence.phase_references: Recovered B traces define costs at the same physical clock. P estimates use calibration from the original P pair before the first expansion. PR uses its observed P reference where available. Original E60 uses its own E30 through 30 s, then the recorded private P or W56 r60 E60 cost. These are scheduling estimates, not timed comparisons between identical controllers.

drain: On detected material throughput loss, stop extra admissions and allow existing qualified attempts to end naturally. The W58 pool still waits for the whole W57 campaign.
